about: Y5-I - the SHELL's bar geometry: the size and orientation of the window content box for every phase at every dock, in CSS px. One table for every character; a character only decides how it fills the box it is given. Wispr rows are [BUNDLE]-sourced from the parity research (section 4.2). Vertical (a column) is the BASE; a row is the override, supplied by the bottom dock or by a banner phase. Rows marked yap_only are Yap phases Wispr does not have, decided by the 30 px crush rule: a phase whose box carries a fixed-width label (a numeral, a note, a clock) cannot live in a 30 px column, so it stays a horizontal banner.

idle.why: Wispr resting bar. No label, so it rotates into the strip.

blind.why: yap24-PILL3: the resting bar with the fn key blocked by Secure Input. Idle's 40x8 box, but a BANNER at every dock: its phase-strip sentence (holder + chord) wraps to three lines and has to sit ABOVE the capsule. Beside a column it overlapped any capsule wider than the 8 px column (caught by the pill matrix).

sleepy.why: The resting bar after a long idle; same box as idle.

model-loading.why: The armed-but-not-yet-listening bar (Wispr ready). A glyph only; the words ride in the phase strip outside the box.

listening.why: Yap's listening bar always carries its stop control beside the waveform, which is Wispr's activePopo (waveform plus cancel/stop), not the bare activePtt 30x73.

listening-locked.why: yap24-PILL4: a latched (hands-free) take is the same live bar as listening; the lock chip and stop hint ride in the shell's phase strip outside the box. Yap's listening bar always carries its stop control beside the waveform, which is Wispr's activePopo (waveform plus cancel/stop), not the bare activePtt 30x73.

transcribing.why: Carries a determinate fill AND a fixed-width numeral (3/12). The numeral crushes in a 30 px column, so it stays horizontal, sized as Wispr processing.

polishing.why: Wispr polishProcessing: 136x30 at the bottom; on a side dock a column with the label hidden. Yap draws no label inside this box, so the column holds nothing that can crush.

pasting.why: Post-capture work, Wispr processing: stays horizontal in both docks.

thinking.why: Post-capture work, Wispr processing: stays horizontal in both docks.

done.why: The completion banner. Wispr keeps it horizontal (152x30) on a side dock; Yap does the same at every dock.

empty.why: An outcome that is not a success, a sibling of error: a banner, sized as Wispr error.

cancelled.why: An outcome that is not a success, a sibling of error: a banner, sized as Wispr error.

error.why: Wispr error 91x30: stays horizontal in both docks.

gated.why: Carries a glyph plus a fixed-width note (the trial-ended headline). Crushes in a column, so a banner, as wide as the widest Wispr working bar.

waiting.why: Carries a fixed-width note (Allow the mic...). Crushes in a column, so a banner.

blocked.why: Carries a fixed-width note (Mic blocked). Crushes in a column, so a banner.

meeting-on-screen.why: Not a take phase: a meeting on screen while no dictation is (the badge and its running clock). The clock is a fixed-width label, so a banner.
